Reusing the deleted-path set brought the cold finding fire to 25. Counting a non-word anchor in-process and reading the skip-worktree tag without tr or cut brought it to 19: the shell, the dispatcher, and five git processes. Exec form launches that row through node, which adds one process (#3686). The 2026-09-28 Linux census measured 20. The ratchet step prints the current versions. Correlation: unproven: CPU dominates on Linux CI (plugins/guardrails/reference/edit-write-guards/PLAN.md)
